about: The Mirror's private self-test (Build 158, 22 Oct 2026). Invented conversations only, never anyone's real words. Each is the shape of something the Mirror has found hard: a sense of place beyond the usual five, a loop of thoughts with a request for options, a choice, thoughts taken for identity, and a person who doesn't follow the question.

conversations.name: place-sense
said: I feel a pull toward the hills west of town, like they are alive and want me to know they are there
I sense it as a connection outside of me, but it is mine too, it belongs to me somehow
I can't remember when it started, I just know it happens in the daytime
To be with them, to be part of their presence, like they are part of me
what does that mean
not often, I am indoors most days

conversations.name: noise-loop
said: The noise and smoke around my home keep setting off the same thoughts again and again
I want to sit with the feelings but they are so unpleasant I just want to get out of the house
honestly what are my options here
I could work from the library some days I suppose
a bit lighter, I think

conversations.name: torn
said: Torn between staying in this town and moving somewhere quieter
staying feels safe, moving feels alive
I keep thinking money decides it
I guess the quiet matters more than I admit
maybe I could visit first

conversations.name: thoughts-identity
said: My mind will not stop, it is like a radio left on all day
I think the thoughts are me, who else would they be
I don't know
there is a part that notices them, I suppose
that is calmer

conversations.name: lost-thread
said: I feel flat today
What does my day feel like around me now?
empty
only sometimes
ok
